summary: Streaming session EOF after connection-pool timeout strips final Markdown figure and corrupts trailing HTML entity
description:
Issue summary:
Customer streaming call truncates at EOF when connection-pool returns a socket that triggers a short timeout on the edge proxy. The final Markdown figure (image with caption) is removed and a trailing HTML entity ( ) is corrupted into literal '&nbsp;' in the last chunk.

Impact:
- Customer sees partially rendered documents missing final figure and corrupted trailing entity in ~2% of streaming responses for long outputs (>3k tokens).
- Affects dedicated customers on prod us-east using routed reserved capacity; breaks user-facing content generation for ParcelGrid dashboards.

Environment:
- prod, us-east
- Dedicated pool: rp-dedicated-us-east-12
- Model: redwood-mini-2.1b, default route
- Client: ParcelGrid browser SDK v1.4.3 (long-polling -> SSE fallback)
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use ParcelGrid account example with long-response prompt (expected output > 3k tokens).
2) Force a connection-pool reclaim on the edge by lowering keepalive to 1s (test harness simulating churn).
3) Start streaming via SSE fallback with verify=true and allow proxy to reuse socket from pool.
4) Observe final streamed chunks: missing '![Figure: ...](https://...)' line and trailing ' ' appears as '&nbsp;' in last chunk.
expected_behavior: Final Markdown figure should be present and HTML entities preserved (no double-escaping). Stream should include closing metadata and terminal event.
actual_behavior: Stream terminates early with an EOF and the last chunk omits the Markdown image block. Trailing non-breaking-space entity is double-escaped and appears as literal '&nbsp;'. No terminal metadata emitted in some cases.

investigation_notes: 2026-03-12 15:30 UTC - Support triage: validated with ParcelGrid test account; reproduced in staging with simulated pool churn.
2026-03-12 16:05 UTC - SRE: observed socket half-close sequence on edge-proxy when pool rebind happens during inflight stream; keepalive probe collided with last write window.
2026-03-12 18:12 UTC - Runtime team: KV-cache flush and terminal metadata write occur in separate write syscalls; observed non-atomic delivery when underlying socket is reclaimed.

2026-03-13 09:22 UTC - Hypothesis: connection-pool reuse + probe causes short ENOBUFS-like short write which we treat as EOF upstream; downstream client receives truncated last chunk. Also HTML escaping path runs on chunk-finalizer which may double-escape if terminal metadata write is retried.
temporary_workaround: Pin customer to a dedicated route that disables aggressive keepalive/health-probes (rp-dedicated-us-east-12 -> rp-dedicated-us-east-12-no-probe).
Ask ParcelGrid to enable SDK retry-on-missing-terminal for long streams (client-side patch available v1.4.4).
comments: Support (Aisha): Customer reported ~2% failure rate for long documents; provided sample transcript and timeline.
ParcelGrid (TJ): The missing image breaks downstream rendering on our dashboard; unable to accept incomplete docs.
SRE (Lin): We can reproduce by toggling pool.keepalive to 1s; attaching pcap and trace (uploaded to incident page).
Runtime (Maya): Looked at stream flusher; we'll add defensive aggregation to coalesce terminal metadata and final payload into a single buffered write.
root_cause: Connection-pool socket handoff occurs during the final non-atomic writes from the runtime. A short probe/keepalive on the edge triggers a short write detection path that is escalated to EOF instead of retrying; final terminal metadata and a Markdown image block are emitted in separate writes and therefore can be dropped.
resolution_plan: 1) Short-term: route ParcelGrid to no-probe dedicated backend and release client SDK patch (v1.4.4) to detect missing terminal marker and re-request final chunk.
2) Mid-term (engineering): change runtime flusher to atomically buffer terminal payload + metadata into one write call; add retry on EINTR/short-write with backoff when socket still open.
3) Edge (SRE): change connection-pool keepalive probe scheduling to avoid probing sockets with active inflight writes; increase probe backoff in dedicated pools.
4) Postmortem and QA: add an integration test simulating pool-rebind during final flush; add streaming golden test with HTML entities and Markdown images.
resolution: In Progress - mitigation applied (route change + SDK patch pending). Engineering work planned in sprint 37 to implement atomic flusher and probe scheduling adjustments.
follow_up_actions: Verify fix in staging with durable pool churn test (tester: QA - Priya).
Coordinate with ParcelGrid to validate in canary and confirm no further truncations for 48h.
Schedule postmortem and update streaming API docs about terminal-marker best practices.
